label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for Monday's admin meeting

Renee,

Here's my rundown for the meeting. Good week all around.

Game: We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday night. That locks up 2nd in the region. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 TDs, and his long one in the 3rd quarter was a good one. Our line pushed them 5 yards back on that whole drive, the best I've seen them block all year. The defense held Brookhollow to 46 yards rushing in the second half. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles, and the kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even got together. That tells you something about this team.

Playoffs: We got a HOME game. We host Clanton Valley Friday, Nov 13 at 7pm at Ridge Field. Please tell Dr. Pruitt, and let folks know we'd love a big crowd out there. The ticket office has presale going. The boosters are also looking for 6 more people on concessions.

Academics: Our 9 weeks grade check came back with all 52 players eligible, nobody on the list. Tonya Greer's Tuesday/Thursday study hall is the reason, and she deserves the credit, not me. She's keeping it going through the playoffs.

Boosters: The Boston butt sale finished at 208 butts sold and $6,240 raised. The goal was $4,500. The money goes toward new sideline headsets. Hargrove's Meat Market did the smoking at cost, so a thank you to them is in order. Carla Mims and the booster club did a great job.

Buses: If we win Friday and go on the road, I'll get the bus request to you right away so it's in 5 days out like transportation needs.

Let me know if you need anything else before noon.

Coach Tillman
